title: Shieldbreaker
summary: Shieldbreaker is a spell used to disable an enemy's protective spell to leave an opening to attack directly.

sections.heading: History
sections.text:
Sophie Casterwill used this spell in Peru to disable a Suit's Blasteater power. [Doorway to Huntik]

Sophie later used this spell to disable Hoffman's Earthband power in Klaus' bookshop, allowing Lok Lambert to defeat him with the Willblade. [The Blood Spiral]

'''Shieldbreaker''' is a spell used to disable an enemy's protective spell to leave an opening to attack directly.

== History ==
[[Sophie Casterwill]] used this spell in [[Peru]] to disable a [[Suit]]'s [[Blasteater]] power. {{source|Doorway to Huntik}}

Sophie later used this spell to disable [[Hoffman]]'s [[Earthband]] power in [[Klaus' bookshop]], allowing [[Lok Lambert]] to defeat him with the [[Willblade]]. {{source|The Blood Spiral}}
